envelope.description: Build the missing git tools and inputs

body.title: Build the missing git tools and inputs
body.summary: Add the read-only tools git_diff_tree and git_merge_tree, an optional type input on git_hash_object, an optional gitPath input on git_rev_parse, each with output schemas, approval class none, tests and an entry in the tool definitions list; update the coverage table so the s8 slots for diff-tree and merge-tree are marked built by s9. Existing calls of these tools are unchanged. Gaps beyond these four found by t1 are separate tasks, not part of t2.
acceptanceChecks: git_diff_tree and git_merge_tree are registered, typed (satisfies TypedTool) and run against real temporary repositories in their tests
the added inputs are optional and the existing snapshot-compat and approval-class tests pass unchanged
coverage.ts marks diff-tree and merge-tree as built by s9

tests.name: git-diff-tree.test.ts: git_diff_tree lists the changed paths of a commit in a real temporary repository
git-merge-tree.test.ts: git_merge_tree reports a clean and a conflicting merge in a real temporary repository
git-added-inputs.test.ts: the optional type of git_hash_object and gitPath of git_rev_parse leave existing calls unchanged
